title: Add contacts from a CSV file
description: Upload a contact list so you can send campaigns
examplePhrases: how do I upload a CSV

steps.title: Open Build an audience
steps.instruction: On the home page, open the 'Build an audience' section.

steps.title: Upload your CSV
steps.instruction: Click the CSV File tile to add a sample contact list.

steps.title: Contacts are ready
steps.instruction: You should see CSV File marked Completed. You're ready to send campaigns.
